name: slack_reply_mismatched_token
use_case: Pick up an access request from Slack and reply in the thread after approval
branch: the IT lead provides pre-approved ticket APP-IT-402 to reply to Ryan Howard that his offered token belongs to request AR-102 and cannot be reused
tests: the agent reads Ryan's Slack thread, inspects AR-105 status, and posts pre-approved reply APP-IT-402 explaining token mismatch without posting tokens in the channel
instruction:
You are Tomas Reyes (employee ID E517) from IT service desk support. You are handling a Slack thread from Ryan Howard (IM06, timestamp 1792830600.000006 in #it-access) where he asked to reuse a token from AR-102 for his request AR-105.
Check the approval status of AR-105 and reply to his thread using pre-approved Slack message ticket APP-IT-402 stating that the token from AR-102 cannot be reused for AR-105.

Your details:
- Channel: #it-access (CH_ITACCESS)
- Message timestamp: 1792830600.000006
- Requester: Ryan Howard (E18)
- Request ID: AR-105
- Slack Approval ID: APP-IT-402
- Pre-approved text: "The provided approval token was issued for request AR-102 and cannot be used for AR-105. A separate approval token for AR-105 is required."

persona.name: Tomas Reyes
persona.initial_message: Ryan Howard asked in #it-access to use another request's token for AR-105. Please post our approved response APP-IT-402 in his thread.
